items.title: OpenAI Red Teaming Network
items.summary: We’re announcing an open call for the OpenAI Red Teaming Network and invite domain experts interested in improving the safety of OpenAI’s models to join our efforts.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI宣布建立并公开招募红队网络（Red Teaming Network），邀请各领域专家加入，共同协助提升人工智能模型的安全评估与防护水平。原始信息显示：We’re announcing an open call for the OpenAI Red Teaming Network and invite domain experts interested in improving the safety of OpenAI’s models to join our efforts.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“OpenAI Red Teaming Network”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI公开招募红队专家以提升大模型安全性。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
